convert_torchvision_to_d2: convert a torchvision ResNet model from .pth format to Detectron2 .pkl format
rename_torchvision_keys: rename torchvision model state dict keys to match Detectron2 naming conventions
map_layer_naming: map torchvision layer naming to Detectron2 res naming for layers 1 through 4
map_bn_naming: map torchvision batch norm naming to Detectron2 conv norm naming convention
dump_pickle_model: dump the converted model state dict to a pickle file for Detectron2 use
